name: Stephens State Forest Free Primitive Camping (Whitebreast Unit)

management_agency.name: Iowa Department of Natural Resources (DNR) - Forestry Division

rules_and_regulations.cost: 100% Free - No fees, no permits required for pack-in primitive camping
rules_and_regulations.guidelines: Primitive pack-in camping allowed at designated primitive sites within the Whitebreast and Lucas units. No vehicle camping inside forest interior.

waste_disposal_rules.trash_policy: Strict Leave No Trace pack-it-in pack-it-out.

campfire_rules.firewood_policy: Gather dead and downed wood only.
campfire_rules.safety_requirements: Campfires in established fire rings only. Must be completely cold before vacating site.

seasonal_weather_effects.spring: 50-65°F, lush green forest floor, spring rainstorms, muddy trails.

seasonal_weather_effects.winter: Cold 20-35°F, snow-covered trails, crisp winter silence.
